name: Chatot

attacks.name: Mimic
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Draw a card for each card in your opponent’s hand.

flavor:
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them
into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t
attack it.
